core_principles.separation_of_concerns: Flame is STRICTLY for rendering. Riverpod is the Single Source of Truth for state, math, and mass conservation.
core_principles.mass_conservation: Particles CANNOT be created out of nothing. Visual spawn must strictly correlate with Riverpod state decrement.
core_principles.visual_standards: Strict CPK color coding for all elements and molecules. No exceptions.

z_index_hierarchy.description: Strict rendering priorities to prevent UI overlap and visual clutter.

component_lifecycle.description: Rules to prevent memory leaks, GC stutter, and zombie particles.
component_lifecycle.spawn: Enforce Object Pool limits. Abort world.add() if max_particle_limit is reached.
component_lifecycle.update_loop: ZERO-ALLOCATION RULE. Do not create new Map() or object instances inside update(dt). Use pre-allocated Float64List or custom mutable classes.
arrival_and_consume: 1. Detect collision/arrival at target hitbox (e.g., root surface).
2. IMMEDIATELY call removeFromParent() to clear from render tree.
4. Execute cancel() on all StreamSubscriptions inside onRemove() to prevent zombie listeners.

nitrogen_cycle.path: POM -> Mineralization -> Bezier curve pathfinding -> Nearest root -> Xylem -> Stem.
nitrogen_cycle.strict_constraint: Zero Zombie Particles. Molecules MUST NOT freeze or accumulate statically on leaves or roots.

symbiotic_network.hotspots: Apply minimum distance threshold (Poisson disk). Prevent overlapping coordinates.
symbiotic_network.mycelium: Must generate FROM plant root TO hotspot. Cannot spawn in empty space isolated from the root system.
symbiotic_network.microbes: 80% physically anchored to hotspot clusters, max 20% free-floating in soil.

atmosphere.movement: Apply x-axis wind drift and Brownian motion (noise). NO rigid, linear pathways.

forbidden_actions.debug_mode: NEVER set debugMode = true in production components.
forbidden_actions.visual_effects: NEVER use MaskFilter.blur with opacity > 0.15 for rhizosphere glow. Do not obscure soil data.
forbidden_actions.code_generation: NEVER truncate code. Do not use '// rest of the code' placeholders.
